title: AI version vs. handmade: show both, side by side
summary: Show the polished AI version of something you make, then the real one you made by hand. Let people compare, laugh or pick a favourite.
why: SocialPilot's TikTok trends roundup, published October 30, 2026, lists "AI vs. Handmade" as a current format: a polished AI version first, then the real handmade one, both bouncing to the same beat.
steps: Pick something you made by hand: a cake, a pumpkin carving, a drawing, a knitted hat, a haircut, a shelf you built.
Use the main prompt to make the AI version from a photo of your real piece or from a short description of it.
Make a Reel or TikTok: the AI image first with "AI version" on screen, then your real one with "Handmade". Cut on the beat so both get the same rhythm.
End with a question in the caption, like "Which one would you rather eat?" Let the comments do the rest.

prompts.label: Main prompt: the AI version
prompts.text: Here is a photo of something I made by hand: [what it is]. Make the "AI version" of it: the same object, same colours and same idea, but polished to look perfect, like a studio product photo. Smooth edges, even lighting, a clean light background, soft shadow underneath. Don't add any text, logos or brand names. It should be clearly recognizable as the same thing, just impossibly neat.

prompts.label: Variation: from a description
prompts.text: Make a realistic photo of a [describe your handmade thing, for example "three-layer chocolate cake with orange icing and a wobbly piped pumpkin on top"], made perfectly by a professional. Bright, clean kitchen counter, natural window light, sharp focus, no people, no text and no logos. Make it look almost too perfect, so it contrasts well with a real home-made version.

prompts.label: Variation: on-screen labels
prompts.text: I'm making a short side-by-side video: an AI-made picture of [thing] and the real one I made by hand. Write 6 pairs of short on-screen labels for the two shots. Keep each label under 6 words. Mix funny and proud, for example "AI: flawless" / "Me: made with love (and panic)". Then suggest 3 short captions that end with a question for comments. No hashtags.

prompts.label: Variation: small business
prompts.text: I run a [type of business, like a bakery, florist or woodworking shop]. Here is a real photo of one of our handmade pieces: [item]. Make an "AI version" of the same item: same shape, colours and size, but machine-perfect and glossy, on a plain light background. Don't add a logo, sign, price or any text. I will post it next to the real photo so customers can see the difference handmade makes.

tips: Always label which one is AI. The trend only works if people know which is which, and it keeps you honest.
Shoot the real piece in the same angle and light as the AI image. The gap is funnier or prouder when the setup matches.
For a business, let the handmade one win: show the little details, the texture and the hands that made it.
Business accounts should pick a sound from the app's commercial library so the post isn't muted.
